Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kr. Chaudhary
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Dinesh Kumar Chaudhary, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.90 of 2019, under Sections 376-D I.P.C., Section 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 3 (2) V of Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act registered at Police Station Gaura Chauraha, District Balrampur.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 17.08.2019 at 16.30 hrs.
against the applicant and an unknown person alleging that at about 11.00 a.m. on 17.08.2019 the informant's daughter aged about 14 years had gone out of her school to ease herself in a field, the applicant caught hold of her hand and started dragging her with ill intention and there was another person with the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that in the night her daughter told her that both the accused persons had raped her.
5. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she stated that the applicant and another person had come to the field and one person had shut her mouth and the other raped her.
She stated that after the incident she had gone to the school and told about the incident to the teacher and headmaster.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she stated that she was present in a lavatory and when she got out, the applicant and one Sahaj Ram followed her.
Sahaj Ram pushed her in a sugarcane field, he pressed her mouth and the applicant raped her.
7. In the medico legal examination report of the victim no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported on her body and the hymen has been reported to be 'torn and fresh'.
In the pathological examination report no spermatozoa was seen.

8. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
9. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail on the basis of instructions.

A perusal of copy of case diary produced by learned A.G.A. indicates that the statements of Taufiq Ahmad and Raghvendra Pratap Singh, headmaster and teacher of the school of the victim indicate that the victim had merely told them that two person had teased her and she had not levelled any other allegation and the victim had not mentioned any name to the headmaster and the teacher.

10. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the discrepancies noticed above, findings of medical examination report and the pathological report coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 24.08.2019 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
